evidence.title: Hubbard Township places moratorium on data centers
evidence.supports: Confirms the 2-1 trustee vote (Trustee Monica Baker abstaining), the one-year duration, and that it was reported as occurring on a Tuesday, consistent with the recorded 2026-02-10 date (a Tuesday).
evidence.quote: Trustees on Tuesday voted 2-1 to approve a resolution placing a one-year moratorium on data centers entering the township.

decisions.notes: This item carried no [VERIFY] marker in the packet, but date_enacted_uncertainty was flagged 'unverified'. Hubbard Township's own website and the Trumbull County Planning Commission's records were checked via web search; no primary resolution text or official minutes were found posted online (the township appears not to maintain a public online minutes/legislation archive). The Vindicator's news account is the best available source and is fully consistent with the recorded date and vote; confidence is capped below the level used for primary-sourced items elsewhere in this pass because no signed resolution or official minutes were located. This February 2026 Hubbard TOWNSHIP moratorium is distinct from the newer June 2026 Hubbard-area action already found by a parallel research pass (per task instructions, not re-researched here).
